Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODShape

ContainsPoint

The ContainsPoint method returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the specified point is within the area of this shape. 
ODBoolean ContainsPoint (in ODPoint point);
point
The point to test, expressed in this shape's coordinate space.
return value
kODTrue if the point is within this shape's area, otherwise kODFalse.
SEE ALSO
The ODPoint type (page 885).
